fx-sel-alt: A running total in arcminutes. The Moon's parallax takes about 58 off; the Moon sitting high in the shadow gives back about 22; the two half-discs give back 32. Without air the total stays 4 arcminutes short of zero. Refraction adds about 59 and the total ends 54 above zero

sel-r-side: Earth's shadow on the Moon, zenith up
sel-r-pa: its angle from celestial north, the same for both
